title: Hardening Platform Reliability: Administrative Governance & Print-Ready Analytics
summary_excerpt: Orchestrated end-to-end platform validation across cross-browser environments, engineered administrative category governance, and integrated native paper-styled printable report engines.
full_story:
As the project neared its final deployment milestone, our primary objective was ensuring every administrative control, data audit stream, and client-facing screen functioned flawlessly without regressions.

Sprint 06 focused on building the centralized System Administration Portal, where campus coordinators can manage job categories, monitor platform usage metrics, and audit active user profiles across Student, Employer, and Staff roles.

Institutional Print-Ready Analytics

A critical requirement of the academic midterm specification was generating formal, printable administrative summaries. Rather than relying on heavy external PDF libraries, we developed a native, CSS3 print stylesheet architecture that formats job posting metrics, department partnership tallies, and applicant logs into formal institutional paper reports with official KLD headers and compliance footers.

Cross-Browser QA & Boundary Hardening

We conducted extensive functional and responsive regression testing across Chromium, Gecko, and WebKit browsers. Edge cases such as session expiration mid-application, invalid schedule slots, and JSON file concurrency safety were rigorously tested and resolved.
key_takeaways: Built centralized category and user management interfaces with real-time JSON sync.
Engineered clean print-formatted institutional reports without external runtime bloat.
Standardized error boundary handlers across all authenticated student and employer views.
Achieved 100% test scenario pass rate across mobile and desktop viewport profiles.

title: Architecting the Department Hiring Pipeline & Candidate Evaluation Flow
summary_excerpt: Engineered the campus department recruitment portal, vacancy management workflows, candidate evaluation drawers, and automated interview scheduling state transitions.
full_story:
Campus offices and accredited industry partners required an intuitive, zero-friction interface to create vacancy listings, evaluate incoming student credentials, and move candidates through structured hiring stages.

During Sprint 05, we built the Employer & Campus Office Recruitment Suite. The core challenge was designing a hiring pipeline that respects academic schedules while keeping supervisors informed of student applicant qualifications at a glance.

Interactive Candidate Review Drawer

We implemented a side evaluation drawer that allows recruiters to inspect student resumes, course year levels, verified institutional emails, and submitted statements of purpose without leaving the applicant queue. Recruiters can transition candidate statuses across Pending, Under Review, Shortlisted, Interview Scheduled, and Hired with instant state persistence.

Multi-Step Vacancy Creation & Slot Tracking

The job posting wizard allows departments to set total vacancies, hourly stipend rates, duty locations, and required weekly time commitments. Automated progress bars visually display filled vs. open slots to prevent over-hiring.
key_takeaways: Engineered role-isolated employer dashboard with real-time candidate pipeline stats.
Developed side-drawer candidate inspector with instant status transition triggers.
Implemented slot progress tracking logic with automatic closing upon capacity fulfillment.
Designed clean notification alerts when applications transition between review stages.

title: Building Intuitive Student Discovery: Weekly Schedule Availability & Live Applications
summary_excerpt: Designed the student job exploration catalog with multi-criteria filtering, weekly schedule availability time grid matching, and frictionless application submission modals.
full_story:
For working students, the biggest hurdle is finding assistantship positions that do not conflict with lectures, laboratories, or exam periods.

In Sprint 04, we concentrated on building the student-facing experience with a strong emphasis on Schedule Matching and Frictionless Application Flows.

Weekly Schedule Time Grid Matrix

We engineered an interactive 6-day (Monday to Saturday) weekly schedule grid where students can visually configure their available time windows (Morning, Afternoon, Evening). This matrix allows candidates to attach their exact availability directly to job submissions, enabling campus supervisors to immediately assess shift compatibility.

Multi-Parameter Search & Status Tracking

We created an accessible job search interface supporting real-time category filtering, stipend vs. hourly toggling, and work setup chips (On-Campus vs. Hybrid). Once applied, students can monitor the exact status of their application through an organized timeline tracker.
key_takeaways: Built interactive weekly availability time grid matrix for student profiles and job submissions.
Crafted multi-parameter search catalog with instant filter chips and pay toggles.
Engineered 'My Applications' tracker displaying live supervisor review stages.
Optimized mobile touch targets for effortless job exploration on smartphone viewports.

title: Securing the Campus Gateway: Real-Time Password Entropy & Session Guard
summary_excerpt: Implemented multi-role authentication gates, client-side real-time password entropy scoring, password strength visualizers, and resilient session timeout validation.
full_story:
User trust begins at the authentication perimeter. With students, faculty supervisors, and administrative personnel sharing the platform, strict role segregation and client-side password hardening were paramount.

Sprint 03 delivered the unified Authentication & Client Validation Engine, providing secure sign-in, account registration with student ID verification, and password recovery workflows.

Real-Time Shannon Entropy Password Meter

Rather than relying on generic regex rules alone, we wrote a standalone vanilla JavaScript password strength analyzer (password-strength.js). The algorithm evaluates character set diversity, length thresholds, sequential character penalties, and entropy calculations to provide dynamic, color-coded visual feedback with real-time criteria checkmarks.

Multi-Role Access Control (RBAC)

We created strict session guard middlewares (auth-check.php) ensuring users can only access endpoints authorized for their authenticated role, preventing privilege escalation and securing private data.
key_takeaways: Engineered standalone vanilla JS password entropy algorithm with zero external libraries.
Implemented dynamic 4-tier visual strength bar with animated checklist validations.
Enforced role-based access control (RBAC) across Student, Employer, and Admin routes.
Standardized input sanitization and form validation across all entry gateways.

title: Crafting the Institutional Identity: Paper Sheet Aesthetic & RA 10173 Compliance
summary_excerpt: Designed the signature Paper Sheet 3D visual language, created the public landing page with interactive journey map, and drafted institutional RA 10173 Data Privacy policies.
full_story:
The KLD Campus Job Posting System needed a memorable, refined, and tactile identity that felt like handling physical institutional paperwork while maintaining ultra-modern digital usability.

Sprint 02 focused on defining the Paper Sheet Design System, implementing the interactive public landing page, and establishing full compliance with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).

Tactile Paper Sheet CSS Architecture

We created a custom design token system featuring an ivory cream palette (--cream: #FBF9F4), deep carbon ink typography (--ink: #161616), and subtle perspective elevations. The landing page incorporates an interactive Accreditation Journey Trail (Section 3) with SVG connectors and official stamp hover effects.

Institutional Privacy & Legal Governance

We authored dedicated Data Privacy and Terms of Service documents tailored to educational institutions, incorporating student data rights, consent checkboxes on registration, and clear guidelines on student assistant workplace ethics.
key_takeaways: Crafted full CSS design token architecture with tactile paper sheet elevation and ink contrast.
Built responsive public landing page featuring SVG journey tracks and interactive hero elements.
Drafted comprehensive RA 10173 Data Privacy Policy and institutional Terms of Service.
Engineered mobile-responsive navigation with offcanvas drawers and smooth reveal transitions.

title: Blueprint to Reality: Designing the Zero-DB JSON Engine & Routing Architecture
summary_excerpt: Engineered the foundational architecture blueprint, zero-database JSON persistence layer, dynamic session synchronization engine, and modular PHP template layout.
full_story:
Every robust web application begins with solid architectural foundations. Our project specification required complete data persistence without an external MySQL or PostgreSQL database, using only native PHP and structured JSON storage.

Sprint 01 laid the core technical foundation of the Campus Job Posting System by establishing the routing protocols, data access abstraction layer, and modular layout hierarchy.

Zero-DB JSON Engine & Session Runtime Cache

We designed includes/data-helper.php, which reads and writes structured JSON datasets with atomic file locking and seamlessly synchronizes runtime states into $_SESSION. This architecture provides near-instant response times, zero database setup overhead, and portable execution across any PHP 8 runtime.

Modular Template System

We established a clean separation of concerns using reusable components (header.php, navbar.php, footer.php, auth-check.php), ensuring strict DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) compliance and seamless maintenance across all 6 team member deliverables.
key_takeaways: Engineered atomic JSON data helper layer with session state synchronization.
Designed modular project directory structure and shared component templates.
Established comprehensive project blueprint and technical data schemas.
Configured session versioning engine to ensure clean data migration during feature updates.
